fields.summary: Move use of fcrepo-camel into a shared OSGi service in fcrepo-camel-toolbox

comments.body: If, in a given Karaf, someone wants to use a couple of different fcrepo-camel instances, that should be possible, right? Are there examples of how to do that here? I'm thinking about someone who wants to manage multiple tiers of service with connections in one workflow container.

In principle, yes – I haven't tried that, but so long as the jndi name of the service is different, one could easily filter on that for the different workflows. I'm using fcrepo/Camel as the osgi service name, but there could be fcrepo/CamelPreservation and fcrepo/CamelFrontEnd and even myinst/Foo. Again, in principle, these jndi names could be made dynamically configurable – I haven't done that before, but it would be entirely possible.
Okay, as long as we are confident we aren't closing off avenues for future ramification...
There are a couple of minor code review comments; otherwise this looks great.
Code review comments addressed in a new commit.

I was in the process of checking this PR one last time before committing to master; however, I can no longer get the build to get beyond the "Fedora LDPath Service" due to test failures. I am repeatedly getting the same error that Travis shows:
https://s3.amazonaws.com/archive.travis-ci.org/jobs/151614101/log.txt

If you can rebase this on master and get a build to work, please push your updates and I will try again.
